editorialRead.readHeadline: openclaw/openclaw is the first source to inspect.
editorialRead.oneLineSummary: openclaw/openclaw leads a 3-item attention queue backed by direct receipts; 29 watchlist sources are fresh, 0 need source-health attention, and movement still requires editorial judgment.
editorialRead.dek: Agent Pulse filtered 29 included projects down to 3 items worth finite newsroom attention. The queue protects attention; it does not declare winners.
bullets: openclaw/openclaw — 98 commits today and 1 same-day mapped article, 423 below its current daily pace, with 103 hardening-subject points. Inspect the receipt before assigning a story.
NousResearch/hermes-agent — 34 commits landed today. Keep it on watch, but require the next receipt to prove a reader consequence before promoting it.
pydantic/pydantic-ai — No same-day commit, but 1 mapped article landed today. Preserve the mismatch and inspect the source window before following up.
editorialRead.watchNext: The next meaningful upgrade is feedback flow: issues opened and closed, review latency, stale backlog, and the share of work that starts outside the maintainer team.
editorialRead.caveat: Source-code motion and article coverage are collected. GitHub issue flow, PR review timing, community discussion, and private backlog signals are not.

dailyInsight.headline: Check that Stop survives a Gateway restart
dailyInsight.insight: OpenClaw now saves cancellation of a parent waiting for background children before answering Stop, so restart recovery can respect the user's decision.
dailyInsight.mechanism: A yielded parent has no active run controller. The session-abort handler captures its identity, cancels descendants and persists the parent's terminal state before responding, with guards against overwriting a newer turn or reset session.
dailyInsight.whyItMatters: Stopping a child does not by itself tell recovery that its waiting parent must stay stopped. A restart can otherwise revive work the operator cancelled.

actions.label: Test the stop acknowledgment across restart
actions.instruction: On a disposable Gateway containing PR #153271, start a harmless parent that yields to a child. Stop it, wait for the response, restart the Gateway and inspect both states. Check any incomplete-cancellation error separately; do not infer every child stopped from the parent's terminal state.
actions.effort: 20–30 minutes with an existing test installation

receipts.title: Persist the yielded parent's cancellation before the Stop response
receipts.supports: The handler and regression cases cover durable parent cancellation, restart, newer-turn and reset races, and partial descendant cancellation.

receipts.title: Reported live Stop and restart reproduction
receipts.supports: The merged PR reports the original Control UI failure and a repaired model-backed parent/child test across an actual Gateway restart.

confidence.basis: Merged code and regression cases agree with the contributor's reported live restart reproduction; the call is limited to this source-level mechanism.

dailyInsight.limitation: We did not independently run the live reproduction or map the fix to a released package. Parent cancellation can coexist with an incomplete descendant-cancellation error and does not undo completed external actions.
dailyInsight.falsifier: Revise the call if a build containing the repair acknowledges Stop for the captured yielded parent but restart recovery resumes that same cancelled run, or a later patch changes the persistence contract.
dailyInsight.watchNext: A released build and operator reproduction preserving both the parent's terminal state and honest child-cleanup errors across restart.
